We've just been spotted by some enemies.|audio = HardcoreWave1-1.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 1 ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Swift''' is an early-game enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has higher health and speed than the [[Odd]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Swift are Odds that interacted with the Void Gem. Although none of the Odds could be considered ‘alive’ after embracing the Void, many won’t survive the transformation of becoming a Swift as the power of the gem ingrains itself into them. Void Gems are both extremely dangerous and valuable for their strengthening abilities, but it’s surmised that those ‘infected’ can only hear the calling of the eternal nothing.''" ==Appearance== The '''Swift''' has white skin, purple torso and purple legs. It has purple veins on its body. It has bands around its arm and two purple crystals coming out of its shoulders. Has three walking animations it can choose from. ==Strategy== *Decently strong early-game towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Ace Pilot]] or [[Golden Scout]] can be effective at dealing with the '''Swift'''. **Towers with stalling capabilities such as the [[Saboteur]] or [[Electroshocker]] can also be used to slow down the '''Swift''' because of its fast speed. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Swift''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} V1.86.0UpdateLog1.png|'''Swift''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} SwiftCA.png|'''Swift''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellanous}} ModernSwiftIconIG.png|'''Swift''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The appearance of the '''Swift''' is based on the legacy appearance of the [[Quick]]. *The concept art of the '''Swift''' was created by [https://www.roblox.com/users/1610259321/profile @TheClassicRose]. *The '''Swift''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Swift''' added, replacing the [[Quick]]. {{Hardcore|Start|N/A|[[Odd]] & Swift|Wave 1|[[Hefty]]|Wave 4}} {{Voidcore|Start|N/A|[[Odd]] & Swift|Wave 1|[[Hefty]]|Wave 4}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
